name: Vending Machine Business

yield.notes: Per-machine income varies by location quality. High-traffic locations (gyms, offices, schools) earn significantly more.

flags: Capital tied up in machine and inventory

prerequisites: Capital for machine purchase ($1,000-5,000 new or refurb)
startup_checklist: Research high-traffic locations: gyms, apartment complexes, office parks, laundromats
Negotiate location agreement (typically 10-20% commission to location owner)
Stock with high-margin items: beverages, snacks, healthy options
Set up remote monitoring if available to track inventory levels
failure_modes: Location owner cancels agreement after initial investment
kill_criteria: Less than $50/month net profit after location fee and restocking costs
kpis: Net margin after COGS and location fee
sources_note: Income ranges from vending operator community data.
